name: COMP_044
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (74%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs InSitu · Careful review

Benign (22%) stays in the 90% conformal set, though all five similar cases are InSitu [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 74%, Benign 22%, Invasive 2% | Clear lead, Benign second |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu | Two classes not separated |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.96 / OOD percentile 1.0 | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 InSitu [F5] | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 8, 10) · context · Above typical; descriptive only [F2] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 1, 5, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; leans non-invasive [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 4, 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; failed spot check, 0/20 [F4] · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Score below typical in this case · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 1, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; failed spot check, 3/20 · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI spans 0 (-0.005 to 0.007): not shown to reflect the classifier; mitoses and necrosis Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Benign is the true class; the 90% set cannot separate it from InSitu.
- Concept scores mislead; mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) failed spot checks.

## Check on the slide
1. **1, 5, 9**: Confirm atypical cells stay confined within ducts, without stromal invasion.
2. **0, 6**: Look for benign features (fibrous stroma, tubules) that would favor Benign.
3. **0, 1, 4, 8, 9**: Verify the suggested tumor-at-margin call along superior, inferior, medial edges [F7].
